description: This file defines the TestTracing class responsible for capturing, managing, and saving trace events during test execution in Playwright. It handles trace recording, file management, and trace merging.

classes.name: TestTracing
classes.description: Manages trace collection, storage, and finalization for a test, including starting/stopping traces, appending events, and merging trace files.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes trace recording based on provided options or mode.

methods.name: stopIfNeeded
methods.description: Finalizes and saves the trace, merging files if necessary.

methods.name: appendForError
methods.description: Adds an error event to the trace.

methods.name: appendStdioToTrace
methods.description: Records stdout or stderr output into the trace.

methods.name: appendBeforeActionForStep
methods.description: Logs a 'before' event for a test step.

methods.name: appendAfterActionForStep
methods.description: Logs an 'after' event for a test step.
